# 45-Book Reading Challenge

> Mpesa Foundation Academy's 2025/2026 reading challenge — students read 45 books across themed categories, reflect on each book, and climb school-wide leaderboards. Designed around the IB Learner Profile and the theme "Fiction as a Mirror of Humanity."

The platform supports students, homeroom tutors, heads of year, house patrons, and librarians. Students log books and reflections; staff curate challenges, review submissions, run leaderboards, and issue milestone certificates.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Programme overview, goals, point system, categories, IB connections.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Account access for students and staff using an access code.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): School-wide rankings by year group, class, house, and student.

## Optional

- [Reset password](/reset-password): Password reset flow (transient).
